evidence.V1: Double-bit head reads instantly in front, three-quarter and silhouette; top view still shows the twin-blade bar around the gold pommel cap, so it reads from every angle.
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: two big flared blades, then the gold collar and ring as medium forms, then the grip wraps, cheek straps and pommel ball as small detail.
evidence.V3: Wide crescent bits with concave necks on a slim haft, plus a chunky collar and ball pommel, give confident stylised proportions. Symmetry error is 0.0 on X/Y, alignment offset is 0, and the head is seated on the collar.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers catch the light on the blade rims, collar lips, ring and cap (edge close-up), matching the kit bevel width.
evidence.V5: Mostly clean, but the collar close-up (studio + flat) shows faceted, slightly folded shading where the left blade neck curves into the collar. There is also a thin slit between the raised cheek strap and the blade root (429 cross-shell overlaps).
evidence.V6: Disciplined palette: steel-grey blades, gold accent, one teal hue in two values plus ink-dark grip bands. Colourways swap only the hue.
evidence.V7: 2096 tris against a weapon target of 2500 (ceiling 4000): under target.
evidence.V8: Uses one white vertex-colour material with the kit's gold, ink, steel and one hue. Bevels and smooth shading are indistinguishable from the kit anchor.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct: Tool Handle at the grip point, Hull collision, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Faceted/folded shading on the left blade neck where it meets the collar (collar close-up)
Thin dark slit between the cheek strap plate and the blade root on both sides of the collar
top_fixes: Add loops or smooth the curved blade-neck sweep into the collar to remove the faceted fold
Seat the cheek strap plates flush against the blade root (or merge them) to close the slit
Optionally enlarge the blades slightly against the haft length for a stronger head read
